summary: Frontend-only testing per request. Verified CasaLavoroPRO Launch Banner visibility on all public and auth pages, no content overlap, home 'Per le aziende' offer section, registration page offer+countdown, azienda dashboard Subscription panel content, and end-to-end azienda registration with auto-PRO annuncio creation (noleggio).
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardAzienda.jsx is a large page; subscription panel content hard-codes offer copy — consider centralizing with CtaBoxes/Registrati to avoid duplication (3 copies of same bullets/subtitle).

LaunchBanner is injected inside <header>; on /login and /registrati pages (which don't render SiteLayout header, standalone layout) banner still shows via Header component -- confirmed working. Keep in mind for future pages without <Header /> wrapper, banner won't appear.

console shows repeated 401 errors on public pages (chat/unread-count poll runs for unauthenticated user?). Check Header useEffect guard: it does skip when !user, so 401s likely come from another hook — minor noise.
Register redirect to /dashboard/azienda works, but there is no explicit visibility test for data-testid='register-offerta-lancio' element only on azienda tab; works as expected.
test_credentials: Dynamically-created azienda per run (azienda_<ts>@example.com / Test2026!). Demo credentials from request not needed.
seed_data_creation: Created one Azienda user + one Noleggio annuncio per test run (prefix 'Azienda Test <ts>', titolo 'Trapano Test Noleggio').
context_for_next_testing_agent: All launch-banner UI, countdown, offer section, dashboard subscription panel (no Stripe buttons), and PRO-gated annuncio creation flows verified from UI. No bugs found. Observed 401s in console on public pages are pre-existing (not related to this feature).
